x: So we await the day when Gladwin, Staines, Swain and company might, in the not too distant future, set seriously about this race and take us below 27 minutes!
Coonawara Staines 87. -A tough customer produced by the best of Aussie knowhow.

Who should show up in March but John Thresher, our 1,500 metre record holder until the Gladwin/Staines era, with 3:44.6 set in 1968. John still competes in vet's races in Toronto and can usually clock 36 minutes for a 10k on his 20 to 25 miles per week training.
Gladwin, Staines and Sweeney training up at Battersea one Tuesday evening late in the season. John found himself getting pretty excited last summer when his training started to go like a dream.

We were without Evans, Staines, Foote and Paton but it didn't matter. There was John Gladwin running in the same team as his old friend Mark Sinclair for the first time in years, the pair of them enjoying themselves and the occasion.
